items.question: Which treatment is right for me?
items.answer: Every journey begins with a personalised diagnosis. We listen to you — your skin, your concerns, your goals — before suggesting the most suitable treatment. You can also take our longevity profile quiz online for an initial orientation.

items.question: What is the difference from a classic salon?
items.answer: At Anaj, there is no standard protocol. Every treatment is built for you, that day, integrating your history, your hormones, your lifestyle. Our ancestral manual techniques combined with the most advanced cosmetic innovations deliver results impossible to achieve in a traditional salon.

items.question: How long before seeing results?
items.answer: Many of our clients notice a visible difference from the first session — particularly for the Manual Lifting and Lymphosculpt. For lasting results on issues like cellulite, spots or hair loss, a course of 4 to 6 sessions is recommended.

items.question: Are your treatments invasive?
items.answer: No. Our treatments are 100% non-invasive. We use no needles, no lasers, no medical procedures. All our techniques are manual or based on high-performance cosmetic actives. They are therefore suitable for sensitive skin and can be carried out all year round.

items.question: How does longevity coaching work?
items.answer: Our coaching programmes are individual accompaniments over 12 weeks or 90 days. They combine studio sessions, remote follow-up, exclusive content and access to our private community. They are aimed at women going through a period of transition — burnout, perimenopause, loss of confidence.

items.question: Do you accept men?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. While our communications are primarily addressed to women, all our treatments are open to men. We adapt every protocol to the specificities of male skin.

items.question: How do I book my session?
items.answer: You can book directly online via our contact form or by calling us. We confirm your appointment within 24 hours. The studio is open every day from 9am to 8pm, by appointment only.
